revisionConflict: Someone changed this record in the meantime. It has been reloaded — review the current values and confirm again.
reasonPrivateHint: Recorded in the private platform audit. Not shown to the organization.
invalidId: Enter a complete ID (the 36-character value copied from the console or the audit log).

plan.limits: up to {products} products and {buyers} active buyers

dashboard.title: Platform
dashboard.subtitle: Operational counts for Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina
dashboard.byCountryDescription: Each organization belongs to one country; trading never crosses borders.
dashboard.definitions: Active organizations only. Users are active, verified business accounts in active organizations. Connections are active relationships whose both sides are active. Pending plan requests include suspended vendors.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.subtitle: Every vendor and buyer organization in both countries
organizations.noneDescription: Invite the first vendor or buyer owner to set up their organization.
organizations.name: Name

invite.title: Invite an organization
invite.description: The recipient gets a setup link to create the organization and its owner account. This is the only way new organizations join.
invite.immutable: Type and country can't be changed after setup. To correct them, revoke the invitation and send a new one.
invite.emailHint: The future owner signs in with this address.
invite.planHint: Vendors start on this plan. Buyers have no plan.
invite.planMismatch: An invitation to this address, country and type is already pending with a different plan. Revoke it first, then send a new one.
invite.sentDescription: A setup invitation for {email} is queued for delivery.
invite.duplicateDescription: An identical invitation is still pending. Nothing was sent again and its expiry is unchanged; resend it from the invitation page if needed.
invite.cardDescription: Invitations you sent from this browser tab. Others can be opened by ID (for example from a SETUP_INVITED audit entry); only the administrator who sent one can view or manage it.
invite.noneThisSession: You haven't sent any invitations in this tab.

invitation.notFoundDescription: It doesn't exist, or another administrator sent it. Only the sender can view and manage a setup invitation.
invitation.deliveryProblem: The email could not be confirmed as sent. Failed or unknown deliveries are never retried automatically — resend the invitation when appropriate.
invitation.detailsDescription: Queued means waiting to be sent, not delivered.
invitation.revokeDescription: The setup link stops working. To invite this person again, send a new invitation.
invitation.resendDescription: A new link is emailed to {email} and the old link stops working. The expiry restarts.
invitation.resendUncertain: We couldn't tell whether the resend went through. Retrying repeats the same request and never sends twice.
invitation.resendStale: The invitation changed in the meantime. Close this dialog, refresh and try again.

SUSPENDED.title: Suspended
SUSPENDED.description: Nobody in this organization can sign in. Orders, stock, roles and prepared work are unchanged. After reactivation everyone signs in again.

CLOSED.title: Closed
CLOSED.description: Closure is permanent. Records stay readable and identity typos can still be corrected, but the organization can't be reopened.

detail.identityDescription: Country, type, currency and owner are fixed. Commercial data is only available through the support view.

lifecycle.alreadyClosed: This organization is closed; its status can't change any more.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: Signs everyone in the organization out immediately and blocks sign-in until it is reactivated. Nothing commercial is cancelled or changed.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: Members can sign in again. Old sessions are not restored.

close.title: Close {name} permanently?
close.description: Disconnects all partners, retires invitations and sessions, and supersedes pending plan requests. History is kept. This can't be undone. All orders must be finished first.
close.openOrders: This organization still has open orders. They must be delivered, rejected or cancelled before closing.

correction.title: Correct {name}
correction.description: For proven typos only. This replaces the current identity details; submitted orders keep their original snapshots.
correction.fixedFields: Country, type, currency, owner, language and business settings can't be changed here.
correction.reasonHint: State how the typo was verified. Private platform audit; the organization doesn't see it.
correction.conflict: This organization changed while you were editing. Your input is kept and the record was reloaded — check it and save again.
correction.identifierInUse: Another organization of this type in this country already uses that registration or tax number.
correction.countryImmutable: The registered address must stay in the organization's country.

members.title: Members
members.description: Accounts of this organization. Accounts never move between organizations.
members.ownerRecovery: Start owner recovery to this member…
members.staffOnlyNote: Administrators can only deactivate or reactivate staff. Owners and admins manage their own team; ownership changes by transfer or exceptional recovery.
members.deactivateDescription: Signs them out everywhere and blocks sign-in. Their organization and history stay; they can be reactivated as staff.
members.reactivateDescription: They can sign in again as staff. Old sessions are not restored.
members.credentialPending: A sign-in or email change for this account is still being completed. Try again later.
members.invalidState: This change isn't possible for this account or organization any more.
members.stale: This account changed in the meantime. The list was refreshed — close this dialog and try again.

recovery.evidenceIncomplete: The evidence system doesn't confirm registration, requester, independent contact, notice to old contacts and no open challenge for this case.
recovery.invalidState: This case can't take that action any more (expired, invalidated or already decided).
recovery.idMismatch: This case was already created with different details. Close the dialog and start a new case.
recovery.replayExpired: The original request is too old to repeat. Open the case from the audit log instead.
recovery.notAvailable: The account or organization isn't eligible, or exceptional recovery isn't enabled on this server.
recovery.credentialPending: A credential change for this account is still being completed. Try again later.
recovery.ownerDescription: Proposes that this existing member becomes the owner of {org}. The current owner becomes a deactivated admin when the member accepts.
recovery.emailDescription: Proposes moving this account's sign-in email to a new address. The account stays in its organization.
recovery.procedure: Requires verified evidence in the operator evidence system, review by a second administrator, a 24-hour notice period and acceptance by the person themselves. Old contacts are notified. You need to confirm your password.
recovery.newEmailHint: Must differ from the current address ({email}).
recovery.evidenceHint: Reference in the operator evidence system (letters, digits and . _ : / -). Not the evidence itself.
recovery.changedAfterSubmit: The details changed after the first attempt. Close the dialog and start again to create a different case.
recovery.notFoundDescription: The case doesn't exist or exceptional recovery isn't enabled on this server.

stateHelp.EVIDENCE_REVIEW: Waiting for review by a second administrator.
stateHelp.NOTICE_PERIOD: Approved. Acceptance opens 24 hours after confirmed notice to the old contacts.
stateHelp.AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE: The person can now accept with the link sent to them, after signing in.
stateHelp.COMPLETED: The person accepted; the change is done.
stateHelp.REJECTED: The review rejected this case. Start a new case if needed.
stateHelp.EXPIRED: Nobody acted in time. Start a new case if needed.
stateHelp.INVALIDATED: The account, owner or security details changed after the case was created. Start a new case if needed.
stateHelp.RECONCILING: An email change is being reconciled with the sign-in provider. Follow the operations runbook.

recovery.caseDescription: Reasons, evidence and addresses are never shown here. Each view is audited.
recovery.reviewDescription: Must be a different administrator from the one who created the case. You need to confirm your password.
recovery.approveHint: Approval queues the acceptance link to the person. The evidence system must confirm the evidence.
recovery.rejectHint: Rejection is final for this case.
recovery.stale: The case changed in the meantime and was reloaded.

vendorPlan.closed: Closed vendors have no plan management.
vendorPlan.noPlanDescription: Vendors get their plan during setup. This vendor has none, and the console can't assign a first plan.
vendorPlan.changeDescription: Applies immediately and supersedes any pending request from this vendor.
vendorPlan.wouldExceed: Current usage doesn't fit this plan

over.products: They have more products than it allows.
over.buyers: They have more active buyers than it allows.

vendorPlan.confirmDescription: The vendor sees the new limits straight away. The reason stays in the private audit.
vendorPlan.limitExceeded: The vendor's current usage exceeds that plan's limits.
vendorPlan.stale: The vendor's plan changed in the meantime and was reloaded. Review it and try again.

connections.connectDescription: Connects two organizations of the same country directly, without an invitation. The vendor's buyer limit still applies. If they are already connected nothing changes and the existing connection is shown below, where it can be disconnected.
connections.findBuyer: Find an active buyer in the same country
connections.findVendor: Find an active vendor in the same country
connections.inactive: Only active organizations can be connected.
connections.planLimit: The vendor has reached its plan's active buyer limit.
connections.planRequired: The vendor has no plan assigned.
connections.resultsDescription: The console can't list existing connections yet; connections you create or look up in this tab appear here.
connections.disconnectDescription: The buyer can no longer see this vendor's catalogue or order. Orders are not cancelled and saved work is kept.
connections.disconnectReasonHint: Both organizations can see this reason.
connections.staleRelationship: This connection changed in the meantime. Look it up again before disconnecting.

support.startDescription: Read {name}'s commercial records for a support case. Access lasts 30 minutes, is read-only, and every record you open is audited. Nothing can be exported or changed.
support.reasonHint: Why you need to see this organization's records. Private audit.
support.activeDescription: Read-only until {time} ({minutes, plural, one {{minutesText} minute} other {{minutesText} minutes}} left). Each record you open is audited.
support.notAvailable: The support view has expired or this record doesn't belong to this organization.

report.title: Order report
report.description: Order totals for a period, in the organization's own time zone.
report.hint: Choose a period and show the report.

order.title: Order lookup
order.description: Open an order of this organization by its ID.

products.title: Products
products.description: The vendor's catalogue as stored. Open a product to see its prices and stock.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.description: All of the vendor's promotions, including ended ones.
promotions.name: Name

agreed.title: Agreed prices
agreed.productHint: Product IDs match the Products tab.

planRequests.title: Plan requests
planRequests.subtitle: Vendors asking to change their plan
planRequests.nonePendingDescription: New requests from vendors show up here.
planRequests.approveDescription: The plan applies immediately if the vendor's current usage fits it.
planRequests.rejectDescription: The vendor stays on its current plan and can send a new request.
planRequests.vendorMessageHint: The vendor sees this text. Keep it business-appropriate.
planRequests.limitExceeded: The vendor's current usage exceeds the requested plan's limits.
planRequests.alreadyResolved: This request was already resolved or withdrawn. The list was refreshed.
planRequests.stale: The request changed in the meantime. The list was refreshed.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Operational and security events across both countries, newest first. Reasons are never shown here.
audit.lookupDescription: Recovery cases, privacy cases and setup invitations can be opened by ID. Opening a case is audited.

privacy.title: Privacy case
privacy.description: Safe metadata only. The request reason and requester are private.
privacy.assisted: Review, holds, export approval, redaction and closing a privacy case are done by a qualified privacy operator following the assisted procedure in the operations runbook, not in this console.
